data_selection.PhysioNet: All 109 subjects, runs 4,8,12 only. T1=left, T2=right. First 4 seconds of each annotated imagery event. Reject events shorter than 4 seconds, nonfinite/flat windows, or missing required channels. Never stretch a short event.
data_selection.BNCI2014_001: All 9 subjects, T and E sessions. Original classes 1,2 only; trial start +2 to +6 seconds. Keep expert artifact flags.

protocol.resampling: EDF physical units -> microvolt; per-epoch scipy resample_poly to 250Hz; offline evaluation only.
protocol.old_model: Frozen original BNCI2014-004 model, using native-reference C3/Cz/C4 channels. No fitting, threshold tuning, label flipping or target normalization. Reference/montage differs from original bipolar training; exploratory transfer with acquisition mismatch.
protocol.new_models: Nine common motor channels, average reference over these nine within each epoch. Fourth-order causal Butterworth bank; zero initial state per epoch; discard first 0.5s. Fit CSP/scaler/classifier only on clean source training trials.

cross_subject.PhysioNet: 5 fixed subject folds; in each round test one fold, validate next fold, train remaining three. Each eligible person tested exactly once.
cross_subject.BNCI2014_001: 9 rounds; hold one person for test and next person for validation; train remaining seven. Each person tested exactly once.

protocol.cross_dataset: Fixed FBCSP + shrinkage LDA, with no target data or labels used for fit/selection. Train all clean source trials; test all target trials. Two directions. Hyperparameters fixed before evaluation.
protocol.reporting: Report all eligible test trials as primary, clean-only secondary where flags exist, pooled/macro accuracy, per-person scores, confusion matrices, predictions. Subject bootstrap CI resamples people, not correlated epochs. No score-based exclusions.

experiments.method: Frozen original BNCI2014-004 model, using native-reference C3/Cz/C4 channels. No fitting, threshold tuning, label flipping or target normalization. Reference/montage differs from original bipolar training; exploratory transfer with acquisition mismatch.
